title: SREV-048 IPC query symbolic-link buffer contract

data.output: name_buf receives the symbolic-link target when it fits with a local NUL terminator

contracts: name_len is the shared user buffer capacity in bytes and must be even, non-empty, and within the local 4096-WCHAR cap
name_buf input is a NUL-terminated symbolic-link object name inside the shared buffer capacity
empty input name and unterminated input are invalid
kernel object-name copy stops at the first input NUL and does not copy unused output capacity bytes as name payload
ZwQuerySymbolicLinkObject receives an initialized UNICODE_STRING with MaximumLength set to the shared buffer capacity
query output writes use ProbeForWrite and require room for a synthesized NUL terminator

terminator.const: requires one WCHAR beyond returned target
